name: When do I need to emergency disconnect a gas appliance?

mainEntity.name: When do I need to emergency disconnect a gas appliance?

acceptedAnswer.text: An emergency disconnection is necessary if you suspect a gas leak, smell gas, or if a gas appliance is damaged and poses an immediate risk. Other urgent situations include an appliance fire or severe damage to a gas line. In these cases, it's crucial to act quickly: evacuate the premises, call your gas utility company to shut off the main supply, and then contact a licensed plumber for professional disconnection and capping. Prompt action can prevent serious accidents and ensure the safety of your home and family.
acceptedAnswer.description: You need an emergency disconnection if you smell gas, suspect a leak, or if an appliance is damaged and poses an immediate risk. Always prioritize safety and call professionals.
